Trigger.TriggerText:
declare t_1 VARCHAR2(50);
 t_2 VARCHAR2(50);
 t_3 VARCHAR2(50);
begin
 nullchk;
 begin
 select address_1,address_2,address_3
 into t_1,t_2,t_3
 from customers
 where customer_id = :ctrl_blk_1.customer_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and (:ctrl_blk_1.inclterm='Y' or
 sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate));
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error_dist('0302'); -- invalid customer ID
 check_package_failure;
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS
 then
 message('exception 1');
 pause;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if t_2 is not null
 then
 t_1 := substr(t_1 || ', ' || t_2,1,50);
 end if;
 if t_3 is not null
 then
 t_1 := substr(t_1 || ', ' || t_3,1,50);
 end if;
 :s_address_2 := t_1;
 begin
 select short_name, name,
 substr(city || ', ' || state || ' ' || zip|| ' ' ||country,1,250)
 into :s_customer_name, :s_address_1, :s_address_3
 from customers
 where customer_id = :ctrl_blk_1.customer_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and (:ctrl_blk_1.inclterm='Y' or
 sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365));
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error_dist('0302'); -- invalid customer ID
 check_package_failure;
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS
 then
 message('TOO MANY');
 pause;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;

declare
 tmp_custm VARCHAR2(6);
begin
 --- Generating a new contract ID for this customer
 if :ctrl_blk_1.contract_id is null
 then
 tmp_custm := substr(:ctrl_blk_1.customer_id,5,6);
 begin
 select nvl(max(to_number(substr(contract_id,8,3))),0)+1
 into :ctrl_blk_1.contract_id
 from vserv_contracts
 where customer_id = :ctrl_blk_1.customer_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 :ctrl_blk_1.contract_id := tmp_custm || '-' ||
 lpad(:ctrl_blk_1.contract_id,3,'0');
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 elsif :ctrl_blk_1.contract_id is not null
 then
 begin
 select contract_id
 into :ctrl_blk_1.contract_id
 from vserv_contracts
 where contract_id = :ctrl_blk_1.contract_id
 and customer_id = :ctrl_blk_1.customer_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error_dist('0303');
 check_package_failure;
 --GO_ITEM('valid_contract.hospital_level');
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 v_local_time date;
 v_local_date date;
begin
 nullchk;
 --
 -- Check that effective date is >= today
 --
 IF is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;
 if :system.record_status in ('NEW','INSERT')
 then
 if trunc(:eff_date) < trunc(v_local_date)
 then
 show_error_dist ('0501');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if :term_date < :eff_date and
 :term_date is not null
 then
 next_item;
 show_error_dist ('4503');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_RECORD
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure validate_record is
/* make sure all of the not null fields in the contracts table
 are not null before committing the record.
 NOTE: Error code 0201 is 'All required fields must be entered' */
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 if :system.record_status in ('INSERT','CHANGED')
 then
 :valid_contract.contract_id := :ctrl_blk_1.contract_id;
 end if;
 if :ctrl_blk_1.contract_id is null
 then
 GO_ITEM('ctrl_blk_1.contract_id');
 show_error_dist('0201'); -- field must be entered
 check_package_failure;
 elsif :valid_contract.contract_id is null
 then
 GO_ITEM('ctrl_blk_1.contract_id');
 show_error_dist('0201'); -- field must be entered
 check_package_failure;
 elsif :valid_contract.credit_limit is null
 then
 GO_ITEM('valid_contract.credit_limit');
 show_error_dist('0201'); -- field must be entered
 check_package_failure;
 elsif :valid_contract.eff_date is null
 then
 GO_ITEM('valid_contract.eff_date');
 show_error_dist('0201'); -- field must be entered
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_TERM_DATE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure validate_term_date(temp_term_date in date, temp_eff_date in date)
 is
begin
 if temp_term_date is not null
 then
 if temp_term_date < temp_eff_date
 then
 show_error_dist('0500'); -- date must be greater than or equal to eff date
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure validate_character(temp_char in VARCHAR2)
is
begin
 if (ltrim(upper(temp_char),'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ')) is null
 then
 null;
 else

 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_GREATER_ZERO
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure validate_greater_zero(temp_num in number)
is
begin
 if temp_num < 0
 then
 show_error_dist('5308'); -- must be zero or greater
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when VALUE_ERROR
 then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_EFF_DATE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure validate_eff_date(eff_date in date,old_date in date) is
begin

 if :system.record_status in ('INSERT')
 then
 if trunc(eff_date) < trunc(sysdate)
 then
 show_error_dist('0501'); -- eff date cannot be less than sysdate
 end if;
 else
 if trunc(eff_date) < trunc(old_date)
 then
 -- :eff_date := old_date;
 show_error_dist('7313'); -- new eff date cannot be before old eff date
 end if;
 end if;
 exception
 when VALUE_ERROR
 then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
end;
